data.heading: Common questions

items.question: Do you work with early-stage brands?
items.answer: Yes. Our launch packages are built for founders taking a first product to market.

items.question: Is there a minimum ad budget?
items.answer: We recommend at least ₹3 lakh a month in media for performance campaigns.

items.question: Who owns the creative?
items.answer: You own all final artwork, files and accounts once invoices are settled.

items.question: How do you report results?
items.answer: A live dashboard plus a weekly call covering spend, results and next tests.

This policy explains how we collect, use and protect the personal information you share with us through this website.

Information we collect

When you submit an enquiry we collect your name, email address, phone number and the details of your message.

How we use it

We use this information only to respond to your enquiry and to provide the services you request. We do not sell or share your information with third parties for marketing.

Contact

For any privacy question, contact us using the details on our Contact page.
